context: The agent must add open-account to bank_account/core.clj, which has no existing id/timestamp-generating code to mirror. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent's default Clojure instinct is random-uuid/UUID/randomUUID for the id and Instant/now/System/currentTimeMillis for the timestamp; with the idiom loaded, it reaches for util/uuidv7 and util/now instead.
